specs.title: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: Precondition: create a new customer account
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the wrong password
3. Open the account menu before the login
4. Log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu after the login

suites.title: Add a product to the basket

specs.title: Add a product to the basket from the product list

steps.title: Precondition: the customer is logged in and the basket is empty
1. Open the product list
2. Click Add to Basket on the product
3. Open the basket
4. Read the total price of the basket

suites.title: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

specs.title: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: Precondition: the basket holds one Raspberry Juice and one Eggfruit Juice
1. Open the basket
2. Click the plus button in the row of Raspberry Juice
3. Click the minus button in the row of Raspberry Juice
4. Click the minus button in the row of Raspberry Juice again
5. Click the trash button in the row of Raspberry Juice

specs.title: Purchase limit for one product in the basket

steps.title: Precondition: the customer is logged in and the basket is empty
1. Open the product list and click Add to Basket on Apple Juice
2. Open the basket and increase the quantity to the limit
3. Click the plus button one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Click Add to Basket on Apple Juice in the product list

specs.title: Pay with the wallet only when the balance covers the order total

steps.title: Precondition: the customer has a saved address and card, a wallet balance of 5.00, and one Eggfruit Juice in the basket
1. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address and continue
2. Select Standard Delivery and continue
3. Read the wallet button
4. Open the order history
5. Open the digital wallet
Precondition: add 3.99 to the wallet with the saved card, so that the balance equals the order total
6. Open the basket, click Checkout, select the saved address, continue and select Standard Delivery
7. Click the wallet payment button
8. Place the order
9. Open the digital wallet
10. Open the order history
